Q: Create temp table in Azure Databricks and insert lots of rows A:

Temporary table:

Temporary tables store data for the duration of a Databricks session. Use temporary tables to materialize intermediate results for exploratory analysis or SQL data pipelines without creating permanent tables in your catalog

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE TEMP_ITEM (UPC_ID BIGINT NOT NULL);

INSERT INTO TEMP_ITEM(UPC_ID) VALUES (1),(2);

Q: Rails 2.3.14/Rails 1.9.3p125 on FreeBSD 9.0 failed A:

It seems to work when you edit the ruby file conversions.rb and comment out the following line:

remove_method :xmlschema if base.instance_methods.include?(:xmlschema)

Q: Volumes on Docker Compose A:

According to the Compose reference, the external: true attribute indicates the volume is managed outside of this Compose file.
Either you have another Compose file that declares this volume (in the case, you have to docker compose up -d it first), or you have to manually create the external volume first (docker volume create node-red_docker).
